current_checkpoint_note: Farm Awareness / Satellite Field Intelligence campaign, baseline aa236f0 (Checkpoint 1.5 closed clean). Full account: docs/farm-return-next/FIELD_AWARENESS_ARCHITECTURE.md. Named 'Field Awareness' throughout (not the brief's own 'Farm Awareness') to avoid colliding with the existing, unrelated, already-shipped GPS Job Mode startFarmAwareness background-location capability. Decisive Phase 0 finding: real field-specific NDVI/vegetation-index computation is blocked by an already-decided, not-reopened hard policy prohibition on creating a CDSE account (docs/farm-return-next/BLOCKERS.md, 2026-09-01) -- there is no real crop-condition signal available today, at all, only real scene-discovery metadata (mission, acquisition timestamp, cloud cover, footprint-intersection-checked field coverage) from the existing satellite-field-coverage.ts/cdse-stac-client.ts (as they stood at Phase 0 inspection time, both unmodified then; satellite-field-coverage.ts later gained a purely additive export in this campaign's own Codex audit round 1 -- see below; cdse-stac-client.ts remains genuinely untouched throughout). New: src/domain/field-awareness.ts (FieldAwarenessSnapshot/buildFieldAwarenessSnapshot -- freshness/attention/confidence derived entirely from real satellite-observation currency, never a fabricated crop-condition judgement; disclosed product-judgement thresholds in docs/evidence-register.md), src/orchestration/field-awareness/index.ts (getFieldAwarenessForCurrentUser -- verifies field ownership via the already farm_id-scoped listFieldsForFarm, never a new raw id-only query or RLS alone, before any satellite/activity call), src/app/actions/field-awareness.ts (thin Server Action), src/components/farm/FieldAwarenessCard.tsx (the one real farmer-facing surface, wired into FieldDrawer.tsx's existing 'Now' tab -- fetches once per fieldId, no polling). Reuses (unmodified): EngineOutcome/isOk, SatelliteFieldCoverage, ActivityType/CompletionType, listConfirmedJobSessionsForFarm, listFieldsForFarm, field-boundary.ts's boundingBox. No migration -- nothing persisted, computed on demand. Deliberately NOT built this campaign, all documented with rationale in FIELD_AWARENESS_ARCHITECTURE.md: Farm Map visual redesign/per-field attention overlay (item 7 -- no real per-field signal to justify it), live satellite calls inside FarmContext (item 15 -- performance/no caching layer yet; the snapshot type is ready for a future integration), Today/Prompt integration (item 10 -- no real, non-fabricated trigger condition exists), farmer-confirmation/learning hook UI (item 11 -- no mature learning layer to attach it to; the domain shape is ready). Quality gate: 1750/1750 tests (139/139 files), up from 1717/1717 (135/135), +33 new tests. Round 1 Codex audit fixes now in: satellite-field-coverage.ts gained a new, purely additive selectMostRecentUsableSatelliteCoverage export (selectBestSatelliteCoverage itself unmodified) enforcing a required, disclosed cloud-cover usability ceiling and ranking by recency-among-usable rather than least-cloud-globally; field-awareness.ts gained FIELD_AWARENESS_MAX_USABLE_CLOUD_COVER_PERCENT (40, disclosed); a real CDSE provider outage now returns EngineOutcome's UNKNOWN status with its own distinct warning, rather than being conflated with a confirmed absence of coverage. Quality gate: 1762/1762 tests (139/139 files). Round 2 Codex audit fixes now in: UI wording softened ('Latest satellite pass', not 'Latest usable observation'; no 'clear satellite look' claim), real scene-wide cloud-cover percentage now shown; classifyFieldAwarenessConfidence gained a second, lower disclosed cloud-cover threshold capping an otherwise-current observation at medium confidence; classifyFieldAwarenessAttention gained an isProviderOutage flag so a genuine outage stays normal rather than raising worth_checking; confirmed-activity matching now also checks the Actual's own real payload.fieldIds (not just primaryFieldId), gained a disclosed 60-day recency window, and sorts most-recent-first; FieldAwarenessCard now re-fetches on field.polygonCapturedAt as well as field.id, fixing a stale-after-boundary-edit bug. Quality gate: 1774/1774 tests (139/139 files). Round 3 Codex audit fixes now in: classifyFieldAwarenessConfidence simplified to freshness-only, never returns 'high' from satellite evidence (round 2's own cloud-cover-based degradation removed as insufficient -- no threshold on scene-wide cloud cover can prove field-level visibility); confirmed-activity matching now trusts payload.fieldIds alone, primaryFieldId dropped entirely; listConfirmedJobSessionsForFarm's own truncated flag now surfaced as a real snapshot warning. One High finding (tile-edge partial coverage via booleanIntersects) reviewed and rejected: inherited unchanged from satellite-field-coverage.ts's own already-frozen, 8-round-audited Vertical H contract, predating this campaign -- documented as a known, disclosed limitation rather than reopening that closed audit. Quality gate: 1775/1775 tests (139/139 files). Round 4 Codex audit fixes now in: selectMostRecentUsableSatelliteCoverage gained a function-local booleanContains full-containment requirement (round 3's own rejected tile-edge finding, correctly reframed as an in-scope fix to this campaign's own new function rather than the shared frozen selectBestSatelliteCoverage); the activity-truncation warning is now exported (FIELD_AWARENESS_ACTIVITY_TRUNCATED_WARNING) and rendered in its own dedicated card block, independent of satellite-coverage status; FieldAwarenessCard.test.tsx's stale 'high confidence' fixture/assertions corrected to 'medium', with a labelled forward-compatibility test added. Quality gate: 1780/1780 tests (139/139 files). Next: Codex audit round 5.

last_codex_audit.note: Round 4 of this campaign's own audit -- reframes round 3's own rejected finding into an in-scope fix. HIGH, fixed: round 3 correctly declined to modify satellite-field-coverage.ts's own shared, frozen filterEligibleCandidates (booleanIntersects-only, inherited from the closed 8-round Vertical H audit) to fix a real tile-edge partial-coverage gap; round 4 reframed it correctly -- selectMostRecentUsableSatelliteCoverage (this campaign's own new, still-unfrozen function) gained an additional, function-local booleanContains full-containment requirement instead, leaving selectBestSatelliteCoverage completely untouched. MEDIUM, fixed: the round-3 activity-truncation warning was pushed into snapshot.warnings but the card only ever surfaced warnings[0] inside a branch that only renders when coverage is NOT OK -- a genuine truncation alongside normal coverage never reached the farmer; now exported as FIELD_AWARENESS_ACTIVITY_TRUNCATED_WARNING and checked explicitly in its own render block. LOW, fixed: FieldAwarenessCard.test.tsx's own default fixture and two tests still asserted 'high' confidence, a state production can no longer reach after round 3 -- corrected to 'medium', with a new, explicitly-labelled forward-compatibility test preserving that rendering branch's coverage. Full account: FIELD_AWARENESS_ARCHITECTURE.md's own 'Codex audit round 4' section and IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md's matching entry. Rounds 1-3 preserved in IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md. Next: Codex audit round 5.
